blocks.text: Why Excel remains the core tool for media buyers

Media buying relies on data from platforms like Meta Ads and Google Ads. These platforms often provide messy exports. You need a tool to normalize this data. Excel for media buyers on mac is the standard for this. It handles millions of rows and gives you total control over pivot tables and custom formulas.
Essential mac shortcuts for faster reporting
Speed matters when you have five client reports due by noon. Stop using your mouse for everything. Use these shortcuts to move through your sheets.
Handling large datasets without crashing your mac

A single worksheet supports over one million rows. However, your Mac will slow down if you use too many complex volatile functions. Avoid using OFFSET or INDIRECT in large tables. Use XLOOKUP instead of VLOOKUP. It is faster and safer for your data integrity.

Excel often strips leading zeros from Campaign IDs. This breaks your lookup formulas. To fix this, select the column, go to Format > Cells, and choose Text. You can also use the TEXT function to force a specific format. Always verify your data type before running a pivot table.
How to use Lazur to work better in Excel

Lazur is a voice assistant that lives in your Mac notch. It helps you find menu items or explains formulas without taking your hands off the keyboard. Hold ⌥ + ⌘ and ask where a setting is. Lazur will draw a circle around it. This is helpful when you are deep in a complex spreadsheet and cannot find the right button.
If you are stuck on a formula, hold ⌥ + ⌘ and ask Lazur to explain it. It will provide a clear, plain English summary of what the formula is doing to your data.

blocks.text: Media buyers often have many tabs open. Use macOS Spaces to separate your browser from your Excel workbooks. This keeps your focus sharp. If you need to switch between apps, use ⌘ + Tab to move quickly. Keeping your environment clean is just as important as keeping your data clean.

faq.question: Can I use Excel for Mac for large ad datasets?
faq.answer: Yes, Excel for Mac supports up to 1,048,576 rows. Use Power Query if you need to merge multiple CSV files efficiently.

faq.question: Does Lazur work inside Excel?
faq.answer: Lazur is a system-wide assistant. It does not click buttons for you, but it can point at menu items, explain formulas, and guide you through tasks.

faq.question: How do I fix the leading zero issue in Excel?
faq.answer: Change the cell format to Text before pasting your data, or use the TEXT function with a custom format string like 00000.
